title: LIST: November 2026 special non-working days in PH provinces, cities, towns
summary: Here are the November 2026 special non-working days in various localities, as proclaimed by the President

blocks.text: (L-R) Photo from Eastern Samar Wikipedia page; Hermano Puli photo from Tayabas: History, Culture, and Heritage Facebook page; Pintaflores Festival photo from Pintaflores Festival Facebook page
Here are the November 2026 special non-working days in various localities, as proclaimed by the President
MANILA, Philippines – This is a compilation of special non-working days in various localities in the Philippines for November 2026, as proclaimed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

items: November 4 – Quezon Province, via Proclamation No. 1481 s. 2026
November 4 – San Carlos City, Negros Occidental, via Proclamation No. 1482 s. 2026
November 7 – Cuenca, Batangas, via Proclamation No. 1483 s. 2026
November 9 – Eastern Samar, via Proclamation No. 1490 s. 2026
November 10 – Dinas, Zamboanga del Sur, via Proclamation No. 1485 s. 2026
November 12 – Gumaca, Quezon, via Proclamation No. 1486 s. 2026
November 17 – Carmen, Surigao del Sur, via Proclamation No. 1487 s. 2026

blocks.text: Bookmark this page for possible additional announcements from Malacañang. – Rappler.com
